rtr-north-core-01.core.north.sites.netgraph_description:
Layer-3 core router for the North campus. It routes between the campus VLANs
(whose gateways sit on sw-north-dist-01) and carries the two backbone
fibres of the inter-site ring.

netgraph_interfaces.name: lo0
netgraph_interfaces.description: Router ID, IGP and management target

sw-north-acc-01.access.north.sites.netgraph_description:
Access switch 01, North campus. Layer-2 only: the ports are untagged access
ports, and the switch's own management address lives on the Vlan99 SVI
rather than on a port (NG-V009).

netgraph_interfaces.name: GigabitEthernet1/0/1
netgraph_interfaces.description: Desk - pc-north-01 (moved to the window bay)

sw-north-acc-02.access.north.sites.netgraph_description: Access switch 02, North campus - second floor riser.

sw-north-acc-03.access.north.sites.netgraph_description: Access switch 03, North campus - third floor riser.

netgraph_interfaces.name: TenGigabitEthernet1/1/1
netgraph_interfaces.description: Fibre trunk uplink to the distribution layer

sw-north-dist-01.distribution.north.site.netgraph_description:
Distribution switch for the North campus. It aggregates the access-layer
trunks, hosts the SVI gateway for every campus VLAN, and reaches the core
router over a routed (untagged) fibre uplink.

netgraph_interfaces.name: br0
netgraph_interfaces.description: Switching instance carrying the access-layer trunks

netgraph_interfaces.name: Ethernet52/1
netgraph_interfaces.description:
Routed fibre uplink to rtr-north-core-01. No 'vlan' block: this port
is a layer-3 interface, not a bridge port.
